s1.syndrome_frame: Pruritic rash with erythematous annular plaques and perivascular inflammation, occurring after initiation of immunotherapy
salient_findings: Erythematous annular plaques without scale on the arms and legs
Superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils on biopsy
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 70s
Patient has recurrent primary peritoneal carcinoma
Patient is receiving pembrolizumab and ipilimumab
Rash started as an erythematous papule on the right arm 2 months after initiation of immunotherapy
Rash gradually enlarged and spread to involve both legs
Patient denied any new systemic symptoms associated with onset of the rash
Trial of oral terbinafine yielded no improvement
Biopsy from right arm showed superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
PAS stain was negative for fungal organisms

raw.syndrome_frame: Pruritic rash with erythematous annular plaques and perivascular inflammation, occurring after initiation of immunotherapy
salient_findings: Erythematous annular plaques without scale on the arms and legs
Superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils on biopsy
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 70s
Patient has recurrent primary peritoneal carcinoma
Patient is receiving pembrolizumab and ipilimumab
Rash started as an erythematous papule on the right arm 2 months after initiation of immunotherapy
Rash gradually enlarged and spread to involve both legs
Patient denied any new systemic symptoms associated with onset of the rash
Trial of oral terbinafine yielded no improvement
Biopsy from right arm showed superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
PAS stain was negative for fungal organisms

differentials: alk positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of a pruritic rash with erythematous annular plaques, superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils on biopsy, and lack of response to antifungal treatment are consistent with dermatitis, particularly given the context of recent immunotherapy initiation.

rejected.label: pruritic rash
rejected.why: Too general, as it is a symptom rather than a specific diagnosis

rejected.label: atopic dermatitis
rejected.why: No clear indication of atopy or personal/family history of atopic diseases

rejected.label: eczema
rejected.why: Eczema is a broader term that encompasses various types of dermatitis, but the specific findings here point more directly to dermatitis

rejected.label: sezary syndrome
rejected.why: No evidence of the systemic symptoms, lymphadenopathy, or specific blood abnormalities characteristic of Sezary syndrome
